purpose: Teach: 表象/場内/別館/採集/持ち出す/取り返し/備考/呼びかける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業者の表象、本気で、絶対、お父さん、お前にも、絶対、引き継いで欲しい、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The founder's legacy—I want you to inherit it, truly, with absolute conviction. I'm asking you seriously.
lines.style: Slow, weighted opening. The voice of someone handing something precious across time. Pause after the dash. Firm but not harsh—this is a father speaking what matters most.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代の、創業祭の場内、本気で、絶対、忘れずに、保ってまいります、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Since your time, Father, I will keep that founding spirit alive in every gathering, every moment—with gratitude and absolute care.
lines.style: Steady, formal respect. Each phrase settled into place. The voice of a son who has understood the weight. Slight lift on the gratitude—this is genuine, not ceremonial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の別館、本気で、絶対、私の、宝物、お前にも、本気で、絶対、見せたい、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: That annex from the founding days—it was my treasure. I want you to see it, to know it. I'm asking you from the heart.
lines.style: Tender underneath the formality. The voice softens on 'treasure'—a moment of vulnerability. Pace slows. Like he's showing you something he's kept safe for decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、データ採集、慎重に、続けております、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Since your time, I've carefully kept those records, those memories. I carry them forward with gratitude and deep respect.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not reciting—remembering. The voice of someone who has held these things close without complaint. Steady rhythm, like a ritual performed with genuine care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の機密、本気で、絶対、お父さん、外に、絶対、持ち出すことが、なかった、お前にも、本気で、絶対、伝えたい、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The secrets we kept in those early days—your father never spoke of them outside these walls. I want you to understand that weight, that trust.
lines.style: Hushed, almost confessional. The voice drops. This is about honor, about silence kept. Slight breath before 'that weight'—acknowledging the responsibility being passed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、取り返しのつかない、決断、絶対、避けてきました、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. We have never made a decision we couldn't undo, never abandoned what matters. Since your time—I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative. The voice speaks like someone tending a flame. Careful articulation on the key phrases. No rushing—each word has been chosen and lived.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お得意様への、お便りの備考、本気で、絶対、お父さん、丁寧に、絶対、書いてきたぞ、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: The letters to our best clients—your father wrote each one with care, with his own hand. I'm asking you to do the same.
lines.style: Clear, direct. A specific instruction wrapped in affection. The voice carries the memory of those careful letters. Slight emphasis on 'care'—this is not just duty, it's love made tangible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、創業精神、呼びかけることを、忘れません、本気で、感謝、しております
lines.en: Yes. I will never forget to call the founding spirit forward in everything we do—with my people, with gratitude, always.
lines.style: Closing statement, calm and sure. The voice settles into certainty. No performance—just a son, older now himself, speaking what he will carry forward. Warm finality.
